policy: Inventory alone never grants publication. Once Systemia explicitly classifies a product as demonstrable, a public discovery surface is required even when checkout is disabled.

states.demonstrable: Public discovery surface required. Sale is optional and separately gated.
states.commercial_ready: Public surface plus explicit commercial state required.
states.sell_now: Public surface plus independently verified sale path may be exposed.
